import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, paginating through all pages."""
    titles = []
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}
    url = "/tickets"
    while url is not None:
        data = fetch_json(client, url, params=params)
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in data["items"])
        url = data.get("next")
    return titles

import httpx
from api_fetch import fetch_json


def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, paginated."""
    titles = []
    status = "open"
    url = "/tickets"
    params = {"status": status, "project": project}
    max_pages = 100

    for _ in range(max_pages):
        data = fetch_json(client, url, params=params)
        titles.extend(item["title"] for item in data["items"])
        next_url = data.get("next")
        if not next_url:
            break
        url = next_url
        # params must be sent with every page request as per server requirement
        # so keep params unchanged

    return titles

import httpx

def open_ticket_titles(client: httpx.Client, project: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return all titles of open tickets for the given project, following paginated results."""
    titles = []
    path = "/tickets"
    params = {"status": "open", "project": project}

    while path is not None:
        response = client.get(path, params=params)
        response.raise_for_status()
        data = response.json()
        for item in data.get("items", []):
            titles.append(item.get("title", ""))
        path = data.get("next")
        # The server requires status and project on every request, so keep params unchanged for next page.

    return titles
